bio: Introducing the seductive world of Sora to Manchester! Sitting above the city on the seventh floor of Malmaison Manchester Deansgate, this is a dining concept to elevate the senses.  Take your Afternoon Tea experience to new heights, surrounded by the stunning views of the city skyline. This is not your average afternoon tea, at Sora you’ll be taken on a sensory journey to the Orient, where pan-Asian savouries, sweet treats and stylish surroundings elevate your senses and tantalise your tastebuds.
